_comment: Curated raw-material purchase manifest for scripts/whistlebird_migration.py (post-legacy-cutoff botanicals, 2025-05-13 onward). 'clean' records are real jill@alembics.co.nz order-confirmation emails, imported as dated receipts without allocation to a specific consuming batch (same policy as legacy raw materials, WB-018). 'resolved_by_context' records have no email or database purchase evidence -- each is sized to exactly the named batch's own 2x-multiplied recipe requirement and dated 3 days before that batch's maceration date; supplier per the founder's 2026-09-14 supplier list (updated same day to add Szechuan pepper -> Davis Trading and Green tea -> Countdown/Woolworths), not verified against a receipt. Founder-confirmed 2026-09-14: each distillation runs two multi-shot concentrates into one VAT, so real per-batch consumption is 2x the founder's stated per-shot recipe quantity.
excluded_from_recipe: Fresh/foraged items never tracked as purchases, per founder (2026-09-14): Wildflower's Lemon juice, Grapefruit (pink) juice, Lemon peel; Solstice's Kawakawa leaf, fresh orange peel, fresh orange juice.
